AdapterCapabilities.description:
The exact capability envelope an adapter/translator declares for one Bronze
port. IDL schema token ``ergasterion.adapter-capabilities/v1``.
AdapterCapabilities.title: AdapterCapabilities

BronzeProductContract.description:
The Bronze Product Contract: a source's identity, product facts, source-native
schema/codec, delivery policy and published projection, authored once (IDL record
``BronzeProductContract``, schema token ``ergasterion.bronze-product/v1``).
BronzeProductContract.title: BronzeProductContract

DeploymentLifecycleRequest.description:
A caller's request to register or activate a runtime deployment. IDL schema
token ``ergasterion.deployment-lifecycle-request/v1``.
DeploymentLifecycleRequest.title: DeploymentLifecycleRequest

HandoffSchemaId.description:
The closed set of target-neutral handoff schema identities an edge can carry.
Full record shapes live in the frozen IDL
``docs/specifications/bronze-portable-idl-v1.json``; this registry names the
identity only, for edge typing and conformance checks.
HandoffSchemaId.title: HandoffSchemaId

InterfaceReadiness.description:
The result of checking one deployment's declared adapters against the contract
and manifest they claim to serve, before it may accept traffic. IDL schema token
``ergasterion.interface-readiness/v1``.
InterfaceReadiness.title: InterfaceReadiness

PatternId.description:
The closed, exact registry identity for all fifteen canonical patterns.

Identity is separate from display text: see ``PATTERN_DISPLAY_NAMES`` in
``patterns.py`` for the human-readable name. Callers use these exact string
values or the enum members; aliases and case-normalisation are never
accepted.
PatternId.title: PatternId

RuntimeBinding.description:
One environment's complete deployment binding for one Bronze product: which
adapters implement each port, which target relations the projection writes to, and
the operating envelope (scheduler cadence, outbox retry, resource ceilings,
retention). IDL schema token ``ergasterion.runtime-binding/v1``.
RuntimeBinding.title: RuntimeBinding

RuntimeManifest.description:
One resolved binding's execution routing table: which translator plays which
role at every occurrence, plus the three digests (contract, execution plan, this
binding) the manifest's own digest is derived over. IDL schema token
``ergasterion.runtime-manifest/v1``.
RuntimeManifest.title: RuntimeManifest

RuntimePortBindings.description:
One binding per Bronze runtime port kind. Every field is a required
``PortBinding``: a deployment binds all nine ports, never a subset.
RuntimePortBindings.title: RuntimePortBindings
